questions:
I. Context and Routine
‎Walk us through a typical daily commute from start to finish for you

II. Storytelling and Recent Experiences
‎Can you describe a specific moment during your commute this week when you felt completely stuck or delayed?
‎

III. Friction Points and Unpredictability
‎What is the most challenging, unpredictable, or exhausting part of your travel routine?

IV. Current Tools and Workarounds
‎How do you currently decide when to leave, what routes or rides to take, or how to handle unexpected delays?

‎V. Ideal Outcomes
If you had a magic wand to change one thing about your current commuting process, what would it be and why?
